english.meaning: advertising slogan for food so tender it melts in the mouth, not in the hand
english.note: Modeled on the M&M's slogan, and often followed by 唔溶喺手度.

exampleSentences.english: It melts in your mouth, right? Beef tenderloin that “melts in your mouth, not in your hand.”
exampleSentences.traditional: 係入口溶吖嗎。「只溶喺口度，唔溶喺手度」嘅牛柳。
